issue.description: Bryan can open Stats (Obsidian) or run `bob stats` (terminal) during the weekly prune, understand how the last weeks went in about a minute, trust where every number came from, and add a new daily metric with a few lines of config — with no daily logging habit and no data written that the vault already keeps.
